# Globale investorer klar til mere risiko

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-09-18  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is a Danish Millionærklubben listener Q&A episode, recorded after the Bank of Japan raised rates and a broad relief rally hit Danish stocks. Guests Michael Friis Jørgensen (Andersen Capital) and Lars Persson (technical analyst, Aktierådet) do not expect Novo Nordisk's capital markets day to move the stock, and Lars's technical model shows a sell signal on it. They see insurance stocks as a sensible defensive hedge while bank stocks lead. Michael would avoid Sandisk and says BlueNord holders should sell after the takeover bid. Lars is interested in nuclear names like Studsvik and Alleima and keeps Per Aarsleff on his watchlist; overall the tone is cautiously positive with plenty of doubt about specific stocks.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🔴 NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **SELL** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Lars has a weekly sell signal and a falling trend; must hold 270, resistance gap at 287. Michael sees no CMD catalyst without new data.

#### Reasoning

Guest technical view (Lars): the weekly model gives a sell signal and the trend is down. A break below 270 opens room for further falls, and it must close the gap at 287 to turn. Guest fundamental view (Michael): the new CEO will show PowerPoints but no new data, and small-molecule gaps remain, so Monday's CMD is unlikely to lift the stock. A cited analyst target of 230 (P/E 10) is plausible. The host holds Novo speculatively.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the price breaks up through the 287 gap
- if the CMD delivers new clinical data or a small-molecule acquisition

> *"der er jo faktisk salgssignal i den, og vi i hvert fald kigger på ugebasis, og den må helst ikke bryde ned igennem de der 270"*

---

### 🟢 RKLB — Rocket Lab | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Michael holds it as a second-best SpaceX proxy; the space sector is recovering after a downturn and upcoming launches could be catalysts.

#### Reasoning

Guest (Michael) thinks the space sector will be on the way up in the coming period after a slump caused by NASA's program shifts. Upcoming rocket launches (third attempts usually succeed) could act as catalysts. The view is explicitly speculative.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the launches fail
- if the space-sector momentum fades

> *"Jeg tror, space er den kommende tid faktisk for at lide optur."*

---

### 🟢 TRYG — Tryg | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Michael: Danish insurers are fairly priced, offer 7-10% expected return and hedge against a bank-stock crack. Lars owns Tryg.

#### Reasoning

Guest (Michael) argues that with investors chasing banks, insurers carry no premium despite being defensive. If rising rates eventually break the economy, money rotates into insurance. A basket of the 3-4 big Danish insurers is a good portfolio protection with a 7-10% expected return. Lars holds Tryg, which pays quarterly dividends.

#### Sell Triggers

- if insurers re-rate to a premium
- if claims inflation rises

> *"Så en god portefølje af de tre danske, eller tre-fire danske store, vil være en rigtig god beskyttelse."*

---

### 🟢 SAMPO — Sampo | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Part of the insurer basket recommendation; best performer this year, with a scale and cost story.

#### Reasoning

Guests see Danish-listed insurers as a defensive hedge. Sampo's case is being the largest, with lower costs from scale. Michael doubts the self-driving-car threat to motor insurance, since repairs cost more.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the cost ratio fails to improve
- if motor insurance premiums erode

> *"Sampo kører på at være den største, og det vil sige få de her lavere omkostninger ud af at være den største"*

---

### 🟢 ALMB — Alm. Brand | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Part of the insurer basket; the synergy story plus good dividends, up from the summer low.

#### Reasoning

Guest (Michael) frames Alm. Brand as a short-term play on merger synergies within the defensive insurer basket. Lars notes a rise from the summer low and solid dividends.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the synergy targets are missed

> *"almindelige brand de kører på synergier, skal det lykkes"*

---

### ⛔ SNDK — Sandisk | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Michael avoids it: the low P/E 7 rests on cyclical memory price rises, new AI architectures need less memory, and the chip sector is weak. Lars sees an uptrend.

#### Reasoning

Guest (Michael) gives three reasons: 1) it sits further down the tech chain than Hynix/Samsung; 2) new AI models reportedly need less memory; 3) the cheap P/E depends on price increases whose cyclicality is unknown, and chip stocks are sold on good news. Guest (Lars) disagrees technically: the trend is up from 1000 to 1600, though weak, so one could build a small position.

#### Sell Triggers

- if memory pricing proves structural
- if the chip-sector sentiment improves

> *"Så nu har du fået de her tre argumenter for, hvorfor jeg ikke vil røre ved den her aktie."*

---

### 🟠 PAAL-B — Per Aarsleff | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Lars has put it on his candidate bench; at P/E 14 it is fairly priced, down to the June support at 650-700 after the cold winter hit construction.

#### Reasoning

Guest (Lars): the stock peaked near 900 and is now testing the June bottom it should hold. The Danish contractor sector is lagging the Swedish ones after the coldest winter in 18 years. There is no buy signal yet.

#### Sell Triggers

- if it breaks below the June bottom
- if another cold winter stalls construction

> *"lige nu siger den ikke til mig, at jeg skal ind og købe den, men den er helt klart en af dem, jeg har hævet ind på kandidatbænken"*

---

### 🔴 BNOR — BlueNord | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 70%

The Vår Energi takeover bid (shares plus cash) removes BlueNord's extreme gas-price exposure, so the hedge thesis is gone.

#### Reasoning

Guest (Michael) recommended it as a gas-price and Iran-escalation hedge. After the bid, holders get Vår shares plus cash, with far less gas exposure, and the stock cannot rise further. He suggests selling and finding another small, gas-sensitive name.

> *"så det kortsvar er jo at sælge den nu"*

---

### 🟢 SVIK — Studsvik | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Lars bought this small Swedish nuclear-services company as a play on the nuclear buildout.

#### Reasoning

Guest (Lars) has taken a position in Studsvik as one of the few listed nuclear-service names. It benefits from a revival in Swedish and European nuclear construction.

#### Sell Triggers

- if nuclear buildout plans stall

> *"Nu har Lav jo bidt til bolle på den lille svenske studsvi der"*

---

### 🟠 ALLEI — Alleima | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Lars suggests it for nuclear exposure: a Sandvik spin-off supplying steel for nuclear plants.

#### Reasoning

Guest (Lars) names Alleima as a supplier to new nuclear builds and something 'man kan kigge på'. This is a suggestion, not a position.

#### Sell Triggers

- if nuclear projects are delayed

> *"Almea, de leverer sådan noget stål til dem, der skal ... som man kan kigge på"*

---

### 🟡 DANSKE — Danske Bank | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 45%

The bank story continues with full employment and loans being repaid, but Lars would rather look at southern European banks. He watches for rate and housing risks.

#### Reasoning

Guest (Lars) earlier advised trimming bank stocks. He still says the Danish bank story continues, keeps his own bank shares, and watches for a housing-market slowdown. He sees more upside in southern European banks and is cautious on Swedish banks because of a planned bank tax.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the housing market turns down
- if rising rates cause credit losses

> *"historien med banker er bare fortsat, fordi vi har stadig fuld beskæftigelse"*

---

### 🟡 NELLY — Nelly Group | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Lars has nearly sold several times but gives it until Black Friday to show progress.

#### Reasoning

Guest (Lars) is holding the stock with low conviction. Black Friday trading is his deadline for deciding whether to keep it.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Black Friday trading disappoints

> *"Jeg giver den lige til, hvad hedder det nu? Til Black Friday."*

---

### 🟢 D05 — DBS Group | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Michael likes Singapore (high-tech, politically stable, avoids China) and banks as the regional hub, but doubts the dollar hedge. He suggests a small 'stamp' position.

#### Reasoning

Guest (Michael) sees three positives: a high-tech economy, an attractive region and no China exposure. Banks are the natural way to play a growing hub, but the region is dollar-sensitive, so the dollar-hedge thesis fails. The recommendation is a small starter position.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Singapore dollar weakens with USD
- if Asian growth slows

> *"jeg var jo egentlig godt mod den region, så et frimærk"*

---
